new_value: {"description":"Cluster 2 of 7ecb. resources.rs:1940 (accept_post path) requires claim.egress_iid == self.info.iid[8..16] (ROUTABLE low half), but the data plane at gateway.rs:1406-1413 builds the lookup route as route = [tunnel_auth_root()] where tunnel_auth_root is the SHA-512 root IID (set at gateway.rs:1047/1074). authorize_decapsulation (tunnel_auth.rs:411-412) requires route.last()==claim.egress_iid AND route_hash match — mutually unsatisfiable, so tunnel egress is permanently fail-closed post-migration. Also resources.rs:1826 own-envelope binding uses routable low half vs wire SHA-512 gateway_iid. FIX: pick ONE plane for egress/root identity on the wire (recommend SHA-512 IID to match tunnel_auth_root + verify_iid_binding) and make acceptance, own-envelope binding, and the data-plane route all use it consistently. Tests must use a realistic coordinator address (routable /128, not [0;8]||iid) — see resources.rs:3224-3226 which currently fabricates a low-half==IID address and masks the bug. cargo test -p lichen-gateway green."}
